description: Source code for the 'git difftool' builtin command, implementing a wrapper around an external diff helper script, managing configuration, directory and file diffs, symlinks, submodules, and external command execution.

classes.name: difftool_options
classes.description: Configuration options for the difftool command, including symlink handling and trust exit code.

classes.name: working_tree_entry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the working tree, used for managing file paths in directory diffs.

classes.name: pair_entry
classes.description: Stores left and right file paths for diffing submodules and symlinks.

classes.name: path_entry
classes.description: Represents a file path used in hashmap operations for tracking changed files.

classes.name: child_process
classes.description: Represents a subprocess for executing external commands, used extensively for running diff tools and git commands.

methods.name: difftool_config
methods.description: Configures difftool options based on git configuration variables.

methods.name: print_tool_help
methods.description: Prints help information about available diff tools.

methods.name: parse_index_info
methods.description: Parses index line information into modes, object IDs, and status.

methods.name: add_path
methods.description: Removes trailing slash and appends a new path segment to a strbuf.

methods.name: use_wt_file
methods.description: Determines if a working tree file can be reused based on its object ID.

methods.name: get_symlink
methods.description: Retrieves symlink content either from the filesystem or object database.

methods.name: checkout_path
methods.description: Checks out a specific object ID to a path in the working directory.

methods.name: write_file_in_directory
methods.description: Writes content to a file within a specified directory, creating leading directories as needed.

methods.name: write_standin_files
methods.description: Creates temporary files for submodules and symlinks for directory diffs.

methods.name: run_dir_diff
methods.description: Performs a directory diff by setting up temporary directories, running the diff, and handling submodules and symlinks.

methods.name: run_file_diff
methods.description: Runs a file-by-file diff using an external diff helper.

methods.name: cmd_difftool
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git difftool' command, handling options, configuration, and invoking directory or file diffs.
